answer_1.quote: To evaluate the effectiveness of the CODEXGRAPH, we assess its performance across three challenging and representative repository-level benchmarks: Cross-CodeEval for code completion, SWE-bench for Github issue resolution, and EvoCodeBench for code generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated code for completion, generation, and patches for issue resolution.

answer_2.quote: In metrics selection, we follow the original papers' settings. Specifically, for CrossCodeEval, we measure performance with code match and identifier match metrics, assessing accuracy with exact match (EM), edit similarity (ES), and F1 scores. SWE-bench utilizes % Resolved (Pass@1) to gauge the effectiveness of model-generated patches based on provided unit tests. EvoCodeBench employs Pass@k, where k represents the number of generated programs, for functional correctness and Recall@k to assess the recall of reference dependencies in generated programs.
